claims: Duke University is located in Durham, North Carolina.
Duke University is a private research university.
Duke University's campus spans nearly 9,000 acres.
Duke University's campus is in the central part of North Carolina.
Durham is part of North Carolina's "Research Triangle" area.
North Carolina's "Research Triangle" area includes Raleigh.
North Carolina's "Research Triangle" area includes Chapel Hill.
Duke University's campus features the iconic Duke Chapel.
Duke University has a presence internationally including Duke Kunshan University in China.
Duke University has a presence internationally including Duke-NUS Medical School in Singapore.
